guiding_principle: SIMPLIFY config, don't multiply options — personas are the funnel. The tutor speaks in the PERSONA's voice (already wired, 1.1.12). Voice-in (talk-to-type) and lesson-recording are simple per-class on/off capabilities, NOT a mode/provider matrix. gemini_live is DEFERRED (only one input mode: stt_tts_roundtrip), so there is NO teacher-facing mode dropdown. The raw class Language/Voice picker is DEMOTED to an Advanced expander. GDPR cleared (paper consent forms, teacher-attested per class).

features.description: Frontend composer mic, talk-to-type XOR record-lesson. One mic control: talk-to-type (hold/tap -> getUserMedia -> STT -> fills the input, edit-then-send default) XOR record-lesson ('Record this class' -> persistent recording banner + Stop -> upload on stop). Explicit recording indicator + resting state + fallback-to-typing. Mutually exclusive (never contend for getUserMedia). Gated on per-class capability flags.
acceptance_criteria: mic control in the composer gated on the class's voice-in capability; press-to-talk -> /api/voice/stt/transcribe -> transcript fills the input (edit-then-send)
record-lesson mode ('Record this class') gated on recording_enabled: persistent recording indicator + Stop banner; uploads to /api/voice/recording on stop; disables talk-to-type while recording (XOR)
explicit recording/streaming indicator + visible mic-off resting state (Axiom 11); graceful fallback to typing when mic/permission unavailable
lib for getUserMedia + MediaRecorder with tests (mocked); no always-on mic
